 1094 people voted early on the first day of early voting for the runoff election in the Northern Marianas for Governor, Lt. Governor, and Attorney General. 
 According to the Commonwealth Election Commission, 933 voted on Saipan, 115 on Tinian, and 46 on Rota. 
 Early voting continues until November 19, 2026. Runoff Election Day is November 20, 2026.
